Adding 251 tablets (batch B009-HC001, expires in 600 days) to that run costs ₹60 in picking and handling rather than a second ₹1,566 vehicle, and averts an expected 251.0 tablets of unmet demand, cutting stock-out risk from 100% to 100%.
